methodology_note: Study units derived from Toronto Notes SOURCE STRUCTURE (toc_inventory.json / derived/scope_packets/G.json). Chapter G is a 'clean' chapter (0 unresolved headings, TOC_VALIDATION PASS) with all 11 level-2 sections and 72 level-3 topics extracted at HIGH confidence (sections) or LOW confidence (TOC_OCR_UNANCHORED topics, meaning per-topic page anchoring was not independently confirmed though the topic titles themselves are unmerged and unambiguous). Two genuine structural points were investigated against the canonical TOC (no independent raw-OCR/body-heading corpus exists beyond toc_inventory.json for this project, so canonical-TOC raw_ocr_line fields were used as the next-best evidence per the resolution order in docs/scope-chapter-workflow.md): (1) G.S04 ('Small and Large Bowel', G14-G41) spans both lower-GI/bowel disease and hepatobiliary/liver disease topics under one printed section heading - raw_ocr_line confirms this is the book's actual printed structure, not an OCR merge, so no split was invented; T-node-level study units still separate bowel and liver content by clinical topic. (2) G.S05 is titled 'Liver Transplantation' (raw_ocr_line confirmed) but its three T-children are cirrhosis-complication topics (portal hypertension, hepatic encephalopathy, ascites) rather than transplant-procedure content; the mismatch is documented per unit rather than relabeling the canonical heading. Consolidation into one study unit (rather than 1:1 per T-node) was applied only where TN's own T-children are etiology-specific subtypes of a single disease entity sharing one MCC evidence citation (e.g., H. pylori/NSAID/stress-induced peptic ulceration; viral hepatitis A/B/C/D; UGIB + Mallory-Weiss; LGIB + diverticular bleeding; colorectal carcinoma + polyps; acute diarrhea + traveller's diarrhea; three structural esophageal-narrowing topics) - generic subheadings (Epidemiology/Pathophysiology/Investigations/Management) were not encountered as separate TOC nodes in this chapter, only named topic/disease headings.

organizational_header_nodes.G: Chapter root container - represented by all study units below, per the C/ELOM/A/CP/D/E/FM convention.
organizational_header_nodes.G.S01: 'Acromyms' (Acronyms) umbrella heading (G2), raw OCR merged_duplicate_headings records 'Anatomy Review'; carries no independent content beyond its three T-children (Overview of GI Tract, Visualizing the GI Tract, Differential Diagnosis of Common Complaints), each represented as its own study unit (SU-G-01 through SU-G-03).
organizational_header_nodes.G.S02: 'Esophagus' umbrella heading (G6); carries no independent content beyond its nine T-children, represented as SU-G-04 through SU-G-10 (three structural-narrowing topics consolidated into SU-G-09).
organizational_header_nodes.G.S03: 'Stomach and Duodenum' umbrella heading (G10); carries no independent content beyond its eight T-children, represented as SU-G-11 through SU-G-15 (four peptic-ulcer etiology topics consolidated into SU-G-14).
organizational_header_nodes.G.S04: 'Small and Large Bowel' umbrella heading (G14-G41); canonical TOC (confirmed via raw_ocr_line, HIGH confidence, chapter G passed TOC_VALIDATION with 0 unresolved headings) spans both lower-GI/bowel topics (T01-T21) and hepatobiliary/liver topics (T22-T36) under one printed section title - this is the book's actual structure, not an OCR merge artifact. Represented as SU-G-16 through SU-G-43 (36 T-children consolidated into 21 study units where etiology subtypes of one disease or a general topic plus its named subtypes share one MCC evidence base).
organizational_header_nodes.G.S05: Section titled 'Liver Transplantation' (G42) but its three T-children (Portal Hypertension, Hepatic Encephalopathy, Ascites) are cirrhosis-complication topics relevant to transplant-listing criteria, not transplant procedure/technique content - raw_ocr_line confirms the title is printed exactly this way in the source (HIGH confidence, not an extraction artifact). Represented as SU-G-44 through SU-G-46.
organizational_header_nodes.G.S06: 'Biliary Tract' umbrella heading (G45); carries no independent content beyond its six T-children, represented as SU-G-47 through SU-G-52.
organizational_header_nodes.G.S07: 'PancreaS' (Pancreas) umbrella heading (G48); carries no independent content beyond its four T-children, represented as SU-G-53 through SU-G-56.
organizational_header_nodes.G.S08: 'ClinicalNutrition' (Clinical Nutrition) umbrella heading (G51); carries no independent content beyond its three T-children, represented as SU-G-57 through SU-G-59.

study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Overview of Gastrointestinal Tract', a T-child of the 'Acromyms' (Acronyms) umbrella section (raw OCR confirms merged_duplicate_headings 'Anatomy Review'). Normal GI anatomy/physiology background.

study_units.title: Differential Diagnosis of Common GI Complaints
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Differential Diagnosis of Common Complaints'; a framework/index topic whose content is the differential-diagnosis lists for presentations (abdominal pain, GI bleeding, diarrhea, jaundice, dysphagia, constipation) that are each covered by their own dedicated MCC presentation objectives elsewhere in this crosswalk.
